submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.122%) at Sb=0.389. Its neighbour at Sb=0.419 gave 0.101%, and compositions further away were much lower: 0.019% at Sb=0.22, 0.0018% at Sb=0.66, 0.0038% at Sb=0.79. So the peak lies around Sb≈0.35–0.40. XRD at Sb=0.30, 0.39 and 0.48 gave the same patterns, so it did not tell the compositions apart.
